title: OGE Runtime World Graph (merged, play-ready)
description: The single game-ready file. It merges each node's behavior, its descriptive stock detail, and its live value into one object, so the game and the graph-update skill both read one artifact. Node values are on the 0-1 scale; edge strength is a 0-1 gain with the direction carried separately in sign. The engine that reads this file is specified in guide/4-the-engine.md. Produced by scripts/build/package_runtime.py.

tick.description: global tick counter; 0 at package time (6 ticks per round)

engine.description: the canonical engine constants, stamped in so both skills agree on the physics (see guide/4-the-engine.md). rates are the (alpha_up, alpha_down) pairs before the speed multiplier.

id.description: unique snake_case identifier; the one id space (a node is its own stock detail, not a separate record)

category.description: functional swimlane grouping (scenario-specific, e.g. Levers/Supply/Outcomes). NOT necessarily a PMESII-P dimension.

type.description: the node's behavior; the only behavior field the engine reads. Clock/Ratio/Zero-sum pool fold onto these (see guide/4-the-engine.md).

stock_type.description: the finer semantic class the behavior 'type' is derived from (see guide/1-how-the-model-works.md)

pmesii.description: the fixed PMESII-P dimension (Physical = Physical Environment)

inverted.description: true when a LOW value is the good state (a threat or compromise node). Load-bearing in the engine: it selects the worse-of term when blending the current and lagged influence, it is not just narration.

baseline.description: resting value on the 0-1 index; deviation is measured from this. Fixed at package time.

current_value.description: the live runtime value on the 0-1 index. Seeded equal to baseline at package time; the only node field the update skill writes.

unit.description: display unit + how it maps to the 0-1 scale

strength.description: unsigned 0-1 gain (how hard the push is). Bands: weak ~0.2-0.4, moderate ~0.5-0.7, strong ~0.8-1.0. The direction is carried by 'sign', not baked in here.

lag.description: transport delay in ticks (6 ticks per round). Selects the source's value 'lag' ticks ago as the lagged comparison term. 0-1 immediate, 2-3 short, 6+ multi-round.

lag_ticks_elapsed.description: ticks of source history available to this edge. Seeded 0 at package time; increments every tick; not reset on a direct change.

mechanism.description: one specific causal sentence: why source moves target
